youtube.title: Why Power Lines Hang So Loose ⚡ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Power lines are strung with a deliberate sag. Metal wire contracts in cold weather, and a line pulled tight in summer could be stretched until it snaps in winter. The sag gives the wire room to shorten safely. Engineers also limit it so that on hot days, when the wire expands and droops, it still clears the ground and trees.
